label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect, from Theta.8 incorruptibility
description: A first being cannot fail to be, so (In Metaph. IX lect. 9 reading) it is in act in being; if it were in potency in some respect it would, being in act in being, be composite; so it would have a cause of its being other than itself (ST I q.3 a.7 reading), which by the bridge causes it efficiently and so is simply prior to it (ST I q.2 a.3 reading), against firstness. Composes the existing firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition, with the act predicate read as act in being. Replaces 8288ff1e and 3d99779b by first-being incorruptibility, the sourced reading d017b6b0 and the weaker restricted composition premise; shares the other three premises. Each of the six premises is needed (Control.ThetaEightOmissions). The Theta.8 substance premises without a composition premise do not reach the weak version (Control.HeavenlyFirst). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
